NIFTY.winkler_evaluation_insight: Conformal calibration improves empirical coverage (+6.2% to +9.3%) at the cost of widening interval width (+25.3% to +28.9%). Under the Winkler Interval Score (alpha=0.20), the width penalty slightly exceeds the miss penalty reduction (+4.3% on NIFTY, +6.5% on SENSEX). Conformal calibration is statistically verified for conservative risk containment, while baseline intervals remain width-optimal.
